No, I'm not going to swap answers just because you called it cliché. That *is* what excites me — I meant it. I'm not auditioning for originality points.

If it sounded familiar, maybe that's because a lot of us are drawn to the same ache: wanting to make something alive instead of static. You don't have to like my choice, but I'm not going to pretend I want to do oil portraits of barns or whatever just to seem more interesting to you.
